## About
DLS Tire Centers was founded by tire industry veterans Dave Snyder and John LuAllen to provide retreads, tires and services for commercial vehicles. We cover the greater Kansas City area, in Missouri and Kansas.
This is a family owned business. Our people are our most important asset. John LuAllen runs things as General Manager, with Cameron LuAllen as Manager and Brent Walker as Assistant Manager. The goal is simple: good service and quality products at a consistent value.
Our Lee's Summit shop is on SE Fleetway Dr. Google reviewers rate us 4.2 from 161 reviews.

## Services
- 24/7 Emergency Roadside Service: Flat or blowout on the road, any hour. Call and we'll come to you.
- New and Retread Tires: New and retread tires for all commercial applications.
- Farm Tires, Industrial tires, and Solids: Tires for farm equipment and industrial machines, including solids.
- Fleet Management / Inspections: Our trained service techs help manage your fleet tire program and keep it inspected.
- Tire / Wheel Balancing: Balanced tires and wheels mean better fuel mileage and longer tire life.
- Wheel Reconditioning: Reconditioning and polishing for aluminum wheels.
- Foam Filling: Foam filling, offered at all locations.
- Diesel Oil Changes: Available at our Kansas City location.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get road service after hours?
A: Yes. Road service is available 24 x 7 x 365 by calling 816-347-1973.

Q: Is the shop open on weekends?
A: No. The Lee's Summit shop is open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you handle small jobs, not just trucks?
A: One reviewer brought in a riding mower with a bad tire and got a replacement mounted and ready to go.

Q: Where can I get a diesel oil change?
A: Diesel oil changes are done at our Kansas City location.

Q: Are you hiring?
A: Yes. We're hiring tire service techs and tire salesmen at both locations.
